<thought>Both the ¹H NMR (only aromatic protons, 5 H) and the ¹³C NMR (six aromatic carbons plus a carbonyl carbon at ~168 ppm) point to a monosubstituted benzene bearing a carbonyl group. The simplest structure matching these data is benzoic acid (C₇H₆O₂). Its SMILES representation is “OC(=O)c1ccccc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>OC(=O)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
